description: Read vehicle_schema first. Recommended recipe.workflow=body_wheels follows concept → references (five wheel-less body views + wheel) → geometry (stop/review) → topology (stop/review) → build (PBR + wheel + rig). Each geometry review uses scene_review with the returned assetRef and must be approved before the next paid step. Rigging preserves UVs and corner normals, GLB/FBX/Blend and measured Chaos setup. Top view is review-only. parts.body.geometry accepts unfinished Hunyuan/Blender GLB; parts.body.topology pins the reviewed reduced GLB; parts.<role>.source reuses finished meshes. Legacy modular_doors remains available for articulated doors. stage=plan quotes each stage without spending; paid stages require its budget. Durable job; poll generation_read. Work draft, real-render review and target-engine driving test required; no automatic publication/replacement.

workspace_id.description: Workspace authorized by the current key. Returned scene links open this workspace.
